page_title: ACM 3-2 TOR | AC Milan v Torino 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+5' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
90+5' My grandmother could have scored that! Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) blazed the ball just over the bar from close range!
90+3' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

90+3' It looks like Niels Nkounkou (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Francesco Fourneau won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to AC Milan in a dangerous position.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by David Odogu (AC Milan).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niels Nkounkou (Torino) replacing Rafael Obrador.
89' A substitution has been made. Enzo Ebosse goes off and Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) comes on.
88' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) attempts to discuss the decision with Francesco Fourneau, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
88' Rafael Obrador (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
85' The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
83' 3 - 2 Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fires the penalty into the top right corner. The spot kick is too good for the goalkeeper.
83' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
82' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
81' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul. A penalty is awarded to Torino!
81' There's a break in play and referee Francesco Fourneau must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Torino using VAR. This could be interesting!
78' Rafael Obrador (Torino) takes the corner with a short pass.
78' A pass by Nikola Vlasic (Torino) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
77' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Christian Pulisic and he is replaced by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).
75' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
74' Substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) in, Gvidas Gineitis out.
73' The current number of shots on goal is 5:6.
71' AC Milan control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
70' Here is a change. Niclas Fullkrug is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Youssouf Fofana leaves the pitch and Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) comes on.

69' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
68' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
65' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) whips the ball into the box and Niclas Fullkrug takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
63' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Che Adams (Torino) replaces Duvan Zapata.
63' It will be a substitution. Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Matteo Prati walks off.
63' Nice passing game by Torino. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
60' Some neat passing and movement from AC Milan as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
59' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rafael Obrador (Torino).
58' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AC Milan.

56' 3 - 1 Goal! Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Zachary Athekame inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. 3:1.
54' 2 - 1 Goal Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan)! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) was put through by Christian Pulisic and he showed brilliant composure to tuck it home from inside the box. 2:1.
53' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) but poses no threat.
52' An attempted cross from Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) is cleared.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
50' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) replaces Fikayo Tomori.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Francesco Fourneau has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

44' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) didn't hesitate to shoot from around the penalty spot and aimed towards the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan was alert, made a superb save and parried the ball onto the post.
43' Torino hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
40' The linesman signals that Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
39' Torino are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
39' Duvan Zapata (Torino) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.

36' 1 - 0 Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) picks up a rebound just outside the box, steadies himself and unleashes a cracker that deflects off the crossbar into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper.

36' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top right corner. Alberto Paleari has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
34' AC Milan enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
29' Torino hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
27' The AC Milan players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
25' The ratio of the ball possession is 54:46.
23' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
22' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. AC Milan are awarded a free kick.
19' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' Nice passing game by AC Milan. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
15' Rafael Obrador (Torino) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
15' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
14' Rafael Obrador (Torino) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
14' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
13' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
11' Rafael Obrador (Torino) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
10' CHANCE! Matteo Prati (Torino) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
8' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Luka Modric (AC Milan) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
4' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
4' Good movement by Matteo Prati (Torino), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
3' Torino work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
3' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Rafael Obrador (Torino), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
AC Milan will kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau will supervise the game today.
